newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at Sept Brent -8 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at Sept Brent -8 cents.

text.p: A dated Brent cargo traded on Friday at Sept Brent -8 cents as players tussled over the direction prices should take, traders said.
The August 28-30 loading cargo was sold by a British major to a Wall Street trader, the same counterparties who traded two Brents on Thursday, at -5 cents and -7 cents.
A third wet Brent moved on Thursday at -29 cents. The promptish cargo was bought from a trader by a European major who said his deal was a fairer reflection of market value.
The expensive Brents were being moved to benefit long swaps positions, dealers said.
